notes.title: Global Double XP and Cash Weekend!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone! We realised that no one was able to get double XP or cash last weekend for 24 hours for Easter Sunday due to an unexpected error with our coding. To say sorry, we wanted to offer you double XP and cash across all levels for 48 hours this weekend! We hope you can accept our apology, and we hope you can get lots of XP and cash this weekend instead!
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40577056/1fffe963b75b40e7aa94f71d7f754deea5256d4a.png[/img]

notes.title: Global Double XP and Cash Day for Easter!
notes.content:

Earn double XP and cash on every map in Crash Drive 3! For one day only! And keep a lookout for some hidden Easter Eggs in-game!
[/h3]

notes.title: Update 5610.2
notes.content:
Addition:
- Events: Every month, players can get double XP and Cash on specific levels. Starts this weekend (12/02-13/02) on Forest. During special holidays like Easter or Christmas, every level has a double XP and Cash boost
- Vouchers: Added vouchers so developers can give out prizes

Fixes:
- Fixed issues with controller navigation in several menus
- Fixed ice mesh and collider on Arctic
- Fixed rendering issues with certain objects in Forest and Desert
- Fixed tag event becoming stuck forever
- Fixed some localisation files
- Minor UI touch-ups and fixes
- Removed unused code, since we're not using it
- Unity Update

notes.title: Crash on!
notes.content:
It has been over a month since the release of Crash Drive 3 and so far 315.000+ users have been crashing and driving! During this month a total of 7.198.464 KM has been driven, 905.874 cacti were pushed around, 43.863 robbers have been caught and 10.197 rockets have departed to the moon!

We have been listening to your feedback and are still actively developing and improving the game, a cool feature we just released is the room code system to easier join your friends from different platforms. Simply share the roomcode found in your pause menu and when your friend enters that code you will be playing togheter in no-time! Another popular request was improvement on the camera controls, we made this more responsive especially when reversing so you always keep track of what is going on. Furthermore we fixed various bugs, crashes and improved performance. You can find a full changelog below.

Please continue to let us know what you think about the game and what we can improve, we would love to hear from you! You can also join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/HD8cpsE

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Room code System. 
[*] Camera doesn't look at the ground anymore while switching to reverse
[*] Camera switches to reverse less fast
[*] Camera look behind now has a better angle and is now instant
[*] More freedom when looking around with a controller
[*] Going in-air while driving reverse now has same in-air sideways rotation controls as CD2, which is more intuitive.
[*] When the player is driving backwards of a ramp without steering, spinning is not inversed

[*] Fixed an issue where playing with a controller gets you stuck in the CD3 friends list
[*] Fix TB area spawning on incorrect platforms
[*] Fixed some texture issues with shadowblob textures on 'low' setting.
[*] Fixed Forest piano sound
[*] Fixed a bug where upon midgame join robbers also have a cop hat
[*] Fixed beachball event sometimes breaking, this can still happen with outdated platforms in your match
[*] Fix tag event sometimes breaking(this can still happen with outdated platforms in your match)
[*] Fixed pickups not being properly removed sometimes in Tank Battles
[*] Spawn rate of pickups in Tank Battles is more consistents
[*] During tank battles, crates will correctly spawn on platforms
[*] Crates will correctly despawn when a new tank battle starts
[*] Fixed an exploit with the 'Daily Reward'
[*] The event message in Tropical now encourages you to go to battle!
[*] Added tank battles to the fast travel popup
[*] Beachball will correctly respawn when it gets out of bounds
[*] Fixed name color option not working on first boot directly into main menu
[*] Added a master volume slider

[*] You will no longer get 2 wins for a tank battle but just one
[*] New car notifications in garage are displayed correctly
[*] Fixed tutorial popups not always properly displaying
[*] Handbrake sound sounding when cars are stationary was fxixed
[*] Adjusted chat category highlight color for consistency
[*] Exclude linux .so.debug files from upload, against cheaters
[*] No longer select the hardest ring on moon for the 'Find the ring' event
[*] Prevent spawning at wrong spawnpointss for Tropical island vs Tank Battles arena
[*] Improved ice collision on Arctic
[*] Fixed Arctic tunnel travel exploit
[*] Slightly longer credits content so you can see Joey, welcome back Joey!
[*] Fixed boost input button reassignment on PC
[*] Rewrote savedata to use a different filename per user
[*] Upgraded engine to Unity 2020.3
[*] Improved performance
[*] Fixed various crashes
[/list]
